intro: Foundational information to help us understand your company profile, HR operations, and current digital maturity.

questions.title: Number of Employees
questions.question: How many employees does your company have?

questions.title: Industry / Sector
questions.question: Which industry best describes your company?
options: IT / Software
Manufacturing
Healthcare
Retail / FMCG
Financial Services
Education
Other

questions.title: Geographical Presence
questions.question: Please tell us about your company's geographical footprint.

intro: Every great journey starts with a clear destination. Tell us about the strategic direction your company is heading in.

questions.title: Our Vision for Tomorrow
questions.question: What are your company's overarching strategic goals for the next 1-3-5 years? (Choose all that apply)
options: Market Expansion (entering new markets, increasing market share)
Cost Reduction/Operational Efficiency
Innovation & New Product/Service Development
Customer Experience Improvement
Employee Engagement & Talent Development
Sustainability & Social Responsibility
Other

questions.title: Embracing the Digital Horizon
questions.question: Is there a clear, company-wide digital strategy guiding your entire business?
options: Yes, we have a well-defined and actively pursued digital strategy.
We have some digital initiatives, but no unified company-wide strategy yet.
We are just starting to explore digital transformation.
No, digital transformation is not a current strategic focus.

questions.title: Digital Echoes Across Departments
questions.question: What key digital projects are currently underway or planned in other departments (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Operations, IT)?

questions.title: Our Biggest Hurdles, Digitally Solved
questions.question: What are the top 3-5 business challenges your company is currently facing that digital transformation could help address?

questions.title: Measuring Our Digital Footprint
questions.question: How does your company define "success" in its digital endeavors? What are the key metrics or indicators you track?

part: Part 2: The Heartbeat of Our Culture & Readiness for Change
intro: Understanding your organizational culture is crucial, as it's the environment in which any digital transformation will thrive or falter.

questions.title: The Fabric of Our Workplace
questions.question: Which best describes your prevailing organizational culture?
options: Innovative & Agile: Open to new ideas, quick to adapt, encourages experimentation.
Risk-Averse & Stable: Prioritizes stability, cautious with new approaches, strong adherence to established processes.
Hierarchical & Structured: Clear reporting lines, decisions flow top-down, emphasis on formal procedures.
Collaborative & Empowering: Cross-functional teamwork, shared decision-making, employee autonomy.
Customer-Centric: Focus on meeting customer needs above all else.
Results-Driven: Strong emphasis on achieving targets and outcomes.

questions.title: Learning from Our Past Transformations
questions.question: Think about major organizational changes or technology implementations your company has undertaken. What were the key successes and failures, and what did you learn from them?

questions.title: The Spirit of Continuous Growth
questions.question: Is there a strong culture of continuous learning and adaptation within your organization?
options: Yes, continuous learning is deeply embedded in our culture.
We encourage learning, but it's not always consistent.
Some departments embrace it more than others.
Not particularly; we tend to stick to established ways.

questions.title: Employee Pulse on Technology
questions.question: What is the general employee sentiment towards technology adoption and digital tools within the company?
options: Highly enthusiastic and eager to adopt new tools.
Generally positive, with some natural hesitation.
Mixed; some embrace it, others are resistant.
Predominantly resistant or slow to adopt new technology.

questions.title: Guiding Change Through Our Doors
questions.question: How is change typically communicated and managed across your company? (e.g., top-down, collaborative, through specific change champions)

part: Part 3: Leadership Driving the Digital Ship
intro: Strong leadership and clear governance are non-negotiable for successful digital initiatives.

questions.title: Our Digital Champions
questions.question: Who are the key executive sponsors for digital transformation initiatives within your company? (Please provide names or roles if comfortable.)

questions.title: The Investment Mindset
questions.question: What is the leadership's appetite for investment in new technologies, especially those impacting internal operations like HR?
options: Very high; they are eager to invest in cutting-edge solutions.
Moderate; they are open to investments with clear ROI.
Cautious; investments are considered carefully and only when essential.
Low; investment in new internal technologies is not a priority.

questions.title: Orchestrating Digital Initiatives
questions.question: Is there a dedicated steering committee or governance structure for company-wide digital initiatives? If so, how does HR typically integrate or "plug into" this structure?

questions.title: Bridging Departments for Progress
questions.question: How do different departments typically collaborate on cross-functional projects, particularly those involving technology?

part: Part 4: The Digital Backbone: Technology & Data
intro: A robust and well-understood technological foundation is essential for any digital transformation.

questions.title: Our IT Landscape
questions.question: What is the current state of your company's IT infrastructure?
options: Cloud-First: Majority of our systems and data reside in the cloud.
On-Premise Dominant: Most systems are hosted internally.
Hybrid: A significant mix of both cloud and on-premise solutions.
Legacy Systems: Heavily reliant on older, perhaps outdated, systems.

questions.title: Navigating Our Data World
questions.question: What are your company's overall data governance policies and practices? How is data quality, security, and accessibility managed?

questions.title: Connecting Our Digital Dots
questions.question: Are there existing enterprise-wide platforms or tools that HR would need to integrate with (e.g., ERP like SAP/Oracle, CRM like Salesforce, project management tools)?

questions.title: Safeguarding Our Digital Assets
questions.question: What is your company's overall cybersecurity posture and adherence to data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, local regulations)?

intro: Understanding the financial context helps us tailor a realistic and impactful HR digital transformation roadmap.

questions.title: Investing in Our Future
questions.question: What is your company's typical budget allocation or approach for technology investments and change management initiatives?

questions.title: The Economic Lens
questions.question: Are there specific financial constraints or opportunities that will significantly influence digital transformation efforts within your company? (e.g., recent acquisitions, pending investments, cost-saving mandates)
